title: Plague Kripath
extract:
The Plague Kripath is an Infested Strike for Zaws that grants  Viral damage.

Acquisition
Plague Kripath is obtainable from limited-time events:
Operation: Plague Star sold Plague Kripath from Nakak for  2,000 +  3,500, requiring Rank 3 - Champion with Operational Supply.
The October 2020, 2022 and 2024 Nights of Naberus event sold Plague Kripath from Daughter for 25  Mother Tokens each.
While the actual Strike itself cannot usually be acquired outside of events, it can still appear as part of a complete Zaw in Hok's Daily Specials.

Characteristics
This strike primarily deals  Puncture damage

14%  Impact
33%  Puncture
23%  Slash
30%  Viral
This Strike also has a Crit Damage Multiplier of 2.2x and a flat +4% Critical Chance bonus.
Compatible weapon types:

Rapier
Polearm

Bugs
Before December 2017, there had been a bug that was fixed without a note in changelogs: while the actual strike itself can no longer be acquired due to the conclusion of Operation: Plague Star, it can still appear as part of a complete Zaw in Hok's Daily Specials.
